question: If cos B=(5)/(9), then what is the value of cosec B?
solution:
Given:

 cos B=(5)/(9)

Concept used:

1. cosecα = 1/sinα

2. sin²alpha + cos²alpha = 1

Calculation:

According to the concept,

 cos B=(5)/(9)

⇒ cos² B=((5)/(9))²

⇒ cos² B=(25)/(81)

⇒ (1 - cos² B)=(1 - (25)/(81))

⇒ sin² B=(56)/(81)

⇒ cosec² B=(81)/(56)

⇒ cosec B=sqrt {(81)/(4 times 14)}

⇒ cosec B={(9)/(2 sqrt {14)}}

**∴ The value of cosec B is {(9)/(2 sqrt {14)}}.**
